b: Home › Legal › No-refund & shipping No-Refund, Cancellation & Shipping Policy Please read this before you pay. Unlock IQ Institute follows a strict no-refund policy. Strictly no refunds All payments made to Unlock IQ Institute Pvt. Ltd. are final and non-refundable. This applies to every exam registration, every digital product and every printed product, including pre-orders. Orders and registrations cannot be cancelled once payment is made. Please check the programme, class, product and your details carefully before paying. Exam registrations Registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable, including if the student does not take the exam. If we are unable to conduct an exam on the announced dates, we will offer the student a rescheduled attempt. Digital products (practice papers, printable books, worksheets) Digital products are delivered instantly and personalised practice papers are generated for your order, so they are non-refundable. If a download link does not work or a file is corrupt, write to us within 48 hours with your order ID and we will re-issue it at no charge. Each child's practice-paper file can be downloaded up to 3 times. The emailed download link works for 7 days; "Find my order" (order ID and mobile number) sends it to your email again. Printed products (books, bookmarks) In-stock items are normally dispatched within 3–5 working days of payment. Pre-ordered books are delivered within 15 days of the order. Delivery across India by courier, typically 4–8 working days after dispatch. Tracking details are sent on dispatch. Damaged or wrong item received: tell us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and we will replace it at no charge. We do not offer refunds or returns for change of mind. Payment problems If money was deducted but your payment failed, the bank or payment gateway reverses it automatically, usually within 5–7 working days. If you were charged twice for the same order, write to us with both payment references and we will reverse the duplicate charge. Contact Email support@unlockiqinstitute.com or WhatsApp +91 77740 66642 with your order ID or payment reference. We reply within 2 working days. All prices include GST where applicable. Our decision on integrity matters is final. Technical issues on our side that prevent an attempt are handled by offering a re-attempt. Fees are non-refundable; see the no-refund policy . 4. b: Home › Legal › Children's privacy & consent Children's Privacy Notice & Parental Consent A plain-language notice for parents and guardians, and the consent we ask for before a child takes part in any Unlock IQ programme. Why we ask for your consent Many participants in AMO, REAL Olympiad, Ramanujan Maths Quiz and UNITE are under 18. Indian law (the DPDP Act, 2023) requires consent from a parent or lawful guardian before a child's personal data is processed. Where a participant is under 18, registration and the processing of their data are therefore handled through the parent or lawful guardian (or through the school with the parent's consent) — never by the child alone. What we collect about your child Name, class, school and city (to run the exam and issue the certificate) Exam responses and scores (to compute results and ranks) For proctored exams only: limited exam-integrity data — camera snapshots taken by the exam platform during the exam and a record of tab-switches (see "Proctoring during exams" below) What we do not collect No location tracking, no biometric data, no social-media profiles. No photographs or video outside a proctored exam, and none used for any purpose other than reviewing exam integrity. What we do not do We do not track your child across the internet or serve them advertising. We do not sell or share your child's data with advertisers. We do not contact your child directly — all communication goes to the parent's registered mobile and email. We do not publish results with names, except a top-ranks list. If you do not want your child's name published, tell us and we will leave it out. Proctoring during exams Olympiad and quiz exams that are proctored (as stated on each programme page) use the exam platform to take periodic snapshots via the device camera during the exam only, and to record tab-switches. This data is used only to review exam-integrity concerns. These are stored for 90 days for the purpose of reviewing any integrity concern, then deleted. Registration includes consent to this proctoring; if you do not agree, please do not register. Your rights as a parent You may, at any time, see the data we hold about your child, correct it, withdraw consent (which ends the child's participation), or ask us to delete it once the programme is complete. b: Home › About About Unlock IQ Institute At Unlock IQ Institute, we believe that every child has the ability to think, question, reason and discover — sometimes they just need the right opportunity to do it. We are a Pune-based education company created with a simple belief: mathematical ability is not something a child either has or does not have. It can be developed. Children learn best when they are encouraged to think for themselves, make mistakes without fear and understand why an answer works — not simply memorise a method. That is why we design our Olympiads, quizzes, practice papers and learning resources around meaningful questions that make children pause, explore and think a little deeper. We also believe that learning should never make a child feel “not good enough.” A wrong answer is often the beginning of understanding. With honest feedback, regular practice and a little encouragement, children can become more confident than they ever imagined. For us, a good question is not only one that produces the correct answer. It is one that makes a child curious enough to say: “Let me try.” That moment matters to us. Through Unlock IQ Institute, we hope to help children build stronger foundations in mathematics, reasoning and problem-solving — but more importantly, to develop the confidence to approach unfamiliar problems without being afraid of them. We are not here to create children who simply score well. We want to nurture children who think well. And we believe every child deserves that opportunity. How we work Academic first. Every paper is reviewed for accuracy, age-appropriateness and fairness before it reaches a student. Reports, not just ranks. Results come with feedback a parent or teacher can act on. Consent-first. Children's data is processed only with parental consent, kept to the minimum, and never used for advertising.
